messages:
elaine wang: Quick sync — final co-marketing playbook & launch timing for the marketplace listings. Can we confirm owners for press, blog, landing, and partner logo approvals?

james ortiz: I can own the marketplace listing checklist (AWS + GCP + Azure). Will need final SKU/cost language from product.

nisha patel: I’ll take press outreach + embargo handling. Draft press release ready, just need the partner quote placeholders.

mike chen: Landing page + demo recording owner here. I can put together a short 90s hero demo.

sara davis: Marketing will own the blog and social cadence. Anne will handle creative/visuals.

anne marketing: Confirmed — creative turnaround is 48 hrs after we get final assets. Need partner logos in vector + approved usage text.

james ortiz: Quick checklist I'm tracking:
```
- Marketplace manifest + pricing copy
- Technical integration notes (1 pager)
- Partner logo assets
- Deployment policy + support contact
- Test listing in staging
```
Will post staging links when ready.

elaine wang: Nisha — embargo window? We have partner preference for a 24 hour heads-up before public?

nisha patel: Partner asked for 24 hours notice, but press outlet windows vary. We'll set embargo at 10am PT on D-day, partners notified 24h prior. I’ll circulate embargo email.

mike chen: Demo checklist:
- short script (30-45s)
- captions + transcript
- staging instance URL
- permission to record partner UI (if any)
I'll drop the script later today.

anne marketing: Creative asks:
- hero image variations (3 sizes)
- partner co-brand banner (1920x600)
- social cutdowns (3 x 15s)
Need all by EOD Tue to stay on schedule.

sara davis: Blog outline: intro -> problem -> joint solution -> how to get started -> CTA to marketplace listing + trial. I’ll draft and tag product for technical review.

james ortiz: For marketplace-specific metadata: who can confirm support policy text and SLA blurb? @mike chen?

mike chen: I’ll sync with infra. We can use our standard Dedicated/Hosted blurb and call out Private as "contact sales".

elaine wang: Risks: partner logo approval delays, partner legal tightening quotes, marketplace certs failing automated checks. If any of those happen we delay public announcement but still submit listings behind the scenes.

nisha patel: Good fallback. Also: press embargo leak plan — if it leaks we shift to rolling release and amplify via customers + partners instead of coordinated press.

anne marketing: Request: partners give final logo + short quote by Tue 12pm PT. If late, we use partner name only (no quote).

press-bot: Reminder: draft press release v1 uploaded to Google Drive: https://drive.example.com/rdx/marketplace-press-v1 (permission: partnerships-read).

elaine wang: Action items summary:
- james: finalize marketplace staging + manifest (due Fri)
- nisha: embargo email + press list (due Wed)
- mike: demo script + staging URL (due Thu)
- anne: creative assets + co-brand banner (due Tue 12pm)
- sara: blog draft (due Thu)
I’ll send a calendar invite for the 30-min dry run on Thu 11am PT.

nisha patel: Adding partner comms thread — tagging legal for quote approval.

james ortiz: FYI: I found one pricing field mismatch in Azure schema, fixing now. Will ping when fixed.

mike chen: Dropping demo staging URL in 30m.

anne marketing: I'll prep alternate hero that doesn't include partner UI in case we need quick signoff.

elaine wang: Perfect — thanks team. If anything blocks, flag here with :warning: and we'll escalate. :thumbsup:
